integrity: Theorem and all-characteristic-five extension-field formula are supported by a symbolic proof; standalone exact enumeration is corroboration only. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the displayed integral Clebsch cubic specialized to characteristic five, not to arbitrary stable models. Complete automorphism group and relative Hilbert-line scheme are not classified; published novelty has residual historical literature risk.
title: Twenty-one rational lines and a split nodal resolution of the Clebsch cubic in characteristic \(5\)
